name: Kanojo wa Ecchi de Midara na Hentai
original_name: 彼女はエッチで淫らなヘンタイ
source:
The protagonist is currently in a dangerous but enviable situation. After his fiancée suddenly transferred to his school, he also received confessions from 3 other girls. At a loss as to what to do, he decides to date each of them one by one.

But in the process, he discovers a peculiar thing - that is, all of them are perverts. And so, surrounded by cute but perverted girls, what will happen to him now!?

[Translated from [url=http://www.ensemble-sweet.com/hentai/story.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
主角目前正陷入一种危险却令人羡慕的处境。未婚妻突然转学到他的学校，随后又有另外三名女孩向他告白。面对不知该如何是好的局面，他决定逐一与她们交往。

然而在这个过程中，他发现了一件奇怪的事——她们全都是变态。被可爱却变态的女孩们包围，主角接下来究竟会怎样！？

[译自[url=http://www.ensemble-sweet.com/hentai/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
